scripts.lint: pnpm --filter ./apps/web lint && uv --directory apps/api run ruff check .
scripts.format: pnpm --filter ./apps/web format && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: pnpm --filter ./apps/web format:check && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter ./apps/web typecheck && uv --directory apps/api run pyright
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:api
